chapter.heading: Psalm 67The Nations Exhorted to Praise God.To the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song.
chapter.v:
God be
gracious and kind-hearted to us and bless us,And make His face shine [with favor] on us— Selah.

That Your
way may be known on earth,Your salvation and deliverance among all nations.

Let the
peoples praise You, O God;Let all the peoples praise You.

Let the
nations be glad and sing for joy,For You will judge the people fairlyAnd guide the nations on earth. Selah.

Let the
peoples praise You, O God;Let all the peoples praise You.

The earth
has yielded its harvest [as evidence of His approval];God, our God, blesses us.

God blesses
us,And all the ends of the earth shall fear Him [with awe-inspired reverence and submissive wonder].
